quote: Assets considered when making a determination of eligibility for financial assistance shall not include
explanation: The policy excludes only part of family savings, so half of savings above $100,000 is still counted for eligibility. Nothing limits this to Medicare cost reporting or patients above 400% of poverty.

quote: Application Period – means the period during which Adventist Health must accept and process
explanation: This is the federal definition of the window the hospital must accept applications in, and the text does not say later applications are denied. It is also unclear the clinic discount program is covered.

quote: a Facility may consider Income and monetary assets of the patient
explanation: The policy lets the facility consider monetary assets and counts half of assets above $10,000. California law now bars considering monetary assets at all.

quote: The Payment Assistance application form requests specific information regarding Qualified Monetary Assets.
explanation: The application requests cash and savings information and does not say it is optional or used only for an allowed purpose. That likely means assets feed into eligibility.

quote: Adverse credit reporting or civil action cannot begin until after the plan is declared inoperative.
explanation: This only limits timing and implies credit reporting may happen once a plan fails. It is old statutory wording, but California now bars such reporting at any time.

quote: Documentation of monetary assets, to include: Most current bank statement, and any additional information or statements on all monetary assets
explanation: The policy requires asset statements and a release to verify asset values as part of applying. Nothing ties this to an allowed purpose.

quote: external collection agencies shall be authorized to file litigation, obtain judgment liens and execute upon such judgment liens using lawful means of collection
explanation: Agencies may obtain and enforce judgment liens with no exclusion for real property. The phrase lawful means of collection offers a compliant reading, but the text does not exclude the home.

quote: Requests initiated beyond 1 80 days of the initial billing will not be considered
explanation: The policy refuses applications made more than 180 days after billing. California law forbids time limits on applying.

quote: as well as assessment of the patient’s monetary assets will be used to determine the qualifying income and asset levels of applicants
explanation: The charity policy plainly uses an assessment of monetary assets to decide eligibility. California law forbids this.

quote: Application Period means the time provided to patients by the CommonSpirit Hospital Organization to complete the Financial Assistance application.
explanation: This defines the federal application period term and does not say late applications are denied. A definition alone does not impose a time limit.

quote: OTHER SOURCES $ DESCRIPTION PAYMENT BALANCE (STOCK, BONDS) *BANK BRANCH (S) & ACCOUNT NUMBERS:
explanation: The form asks for stocks, bonds, savings and account numbers and does not mark them optional. That probably means assets are weighed, though the form alone does not say how.

quote: If the remaining amount is less than $5,000, your total asset level supports your eligibility for Charity Care.
explanation: Charity care eligibility turns on an asset formula. California law forbids considering monetary assets.

quote: Requests initiated beyond 180 days of initial billing will be denied.
explanation: The policy denies discount requests made more than 180 days after billing. California law forbids time limits on applying.

quote: Credit reporting shall not occur until after 180 days of the payment plan being inoperable.
explanation: The policy plans for credit reporting after a plan fails and sets when it can happen. California law no longer allows reporting hospital debt.

quote: PLEASE PROVIDE TWO MONTHS OF PHOTOCOPIES OF PAY-STUBS AND BANK STATEMENTS
explanation: The form requires bank statements and asks for account balances, real estate and vehicle values. These are not marked optional, so assets are probably considered.

quote: Cases can be reopened if documentation is received at a later date.
explanation: The 30 day return window is not final because cases can be reopened when documents come in later. So no hard time limit on applying is imposed.

quote: use as a means of collecting unpaid hospital bills, any of the following
explanation: The sentence is in a list of prohibited collection practices and does not authorize any lien. The narrower wording does not itself impose a lien on real property.

quote: it is the Oroville Hospital intent to inform the bad debt agencies to report the credit agencies
explanation: The hospital states it will have agencies report unpaid accounts to credit bureaus. California law no longer allows this.

quote: stub and bank statement.
explanation: A bank statement may be used only to verify income, and the text does not say savings are counted. It is unclear whether assets affect eligibility.

quote: based on a review of the patient’s monetary assets and family income
explanation: The policy states discount eligibility is based on a review of monetary assets. California law forbids considering them.

quote: Legal efforts (e.g., wage garnishment, liens, and judgements) are allowable if:
explanation: Liens are allowed with no exclusion for a patient's real property or for California patients. A reference to guarantor location hints at other states, but the text does not limit it.

quote: Notify the patient that failure to return the application may result in denial of payment assistance and possible collection activity
explanation: The 30 day mark triggers follow up, and denial seems tied to never returning the application rather than a late one. It is unclear whether a late application would be refused.

quote: Requests initiated beyond 180 days of initial billing will be denied.
explanation: The policy denies charity care requests made more than 180 days after billing. California law forbids time limits on applying.

quote: Requests initiated beyond 180 days of the initial billing will not be considered
explanation: The policy refuses charity care requests made after 180 days. California law forbids time limits on applying.

quote: The hospital will not report medical debt for these hospital services to credit bureaus at any time if you are a financially qualified patient.
explanation: The policy lists credit reporting as a collection activity and bars it only for qualified patients. That implies it reports others, which California law no longer allows.

quote: The attached worksheet proof of all income and supporting documentation must be received within 60 days of the initial patient billing.
explanation: This sets a 60 day deadline from the first bill for the application documents. It could be read as a document deadline, but nothing says the patient can still reapply.

quote: A report to a consumer credit reporting agency will not be initiated or a civil action will not be commenced until the payment plan is declared inoperative.
explanation: This old statutory wording implies credit reporting may follow a failed plan. California law no longer allows reporting at any time.

quote: report adverse information to a consumer credit reporting agency or commence civil action against a patient for nonpayment at any time prior to 180 days after the initial billing
explanation: The ban lasts only 180 days, implying reporting is permitted afterward. California law now bars it at any time.

quote: A portion of a patient’s monetary assets will be included in the gross income calculation
explanation: The policy adds part of a patient's assets into income for eligibility. California law forbids considering monetary assets.

quote: Only one current account statement will be required to verify monetary assets.
explanation: The policy requires an account statement to verify assets for free or discounted care. No allowed purpose such as patients above 400% of poverty is stated here.
